title: Current Holdings
description: The portfolio contents, including cash. Cash is specified using an `instrument_id` of `CASH`.

PositionSize.title: Size
PositionSize.description: The size of the position, with a specified `type` indicating how the size is represented. Par sizes represent the size of the position in face value; most corporate bonds have a face value of $1000. Currently, only par sizes are supported.

holding.title: Holding
holding.description: An individual holding. Cash is specified using an `instrument_id` of `CASH`.
